title: 第17章 人生大起大落的太快实在让人太刺激了第18章 天空一声巨响又有人升天了
slug: 我被系统坑成了造物主
content_zh:
小狸是吃瓜看戏，时不时评头论足一番。
不一会青莲也是越来越迷糊，开始不再抗拒姜云天。
一个半时辰后，姜云天觉得差不多了，时间太久，维持阵法的两个狐狸坚持不住，阵法不得露馅啊。
另一边姜云浩早已筋疲力尽，再加上药物加持，硬是持续一个多时辰，小火现在也是晕倒在地。
这把两个维持大阵运行的狐狸看得也是有些羞骚，目瞪口呆。
小狸就不同，看着姜云天的表现，对姜云天的评价逐渐从好评走向恶评。
她没有想到，姜云天竟然如此地暴力。
姜云天想要打完收工了，但想到今天炼化了青莲的元阴，要是不留下点什么，显得有点不地道，加上一想，万一落地生根，这不是巧了吗，还能完成系统任务。
姜云天这边踏出幻阵。
两个狐狸相互一对眼，迅速收工，把小火收回小狸大阵中。
小火还在昏迷中。
外面，姜云浩还在瘫软中。
这边青莲直挺挺地躺着不动了，一个在回血，一个在回魂。
小狸笑的见牙不见眼，姜云天一脸正经，两个狐狸不敢做声，看着晕在一边的小火，也不敢动。
姜云天回味了一会，心道“这炼阴功法，第一次全程使用，阴气浓郁了不少，阴阳鱼也凝实了一点。”
姜云天这次与青莲的修炼，他能感到青莲灵力流失。
心道：“炼化还可以，不拿也会自然流失，然则炼化对方的阴气，这功法有些损了，几次可能看不出弊病，但多了一定会损害根基，不到万不得已，以后少用。”
毕竟三年前，青莲还没有与姜云天相随，虽然之前对他和青儿呲牙，但是并没有对她们做出伤害之事，还有就是青莲也是青鸟一族的族人，今日被殃及池鱼，也是形势所迫，姜云天还真的是心有怜惜。
姜云天看着一直笑的小狸，又看到两只满眼期待的两只狐狸，心下了然。
看来两只被小狸抓来的狐狸，虽然卖力工作，但是他这个客户要是不满意，小狸一发飙，她俩得一起归西，即使不归西，那一顿折磨估计也得掉层皮。

就笑道“你们俩今天做的不错！
，值得表扬！
！”
两只狐狸满眼感激。
姜云天继续道“小狸，这个四尾狐很有灵性，如果是化为人形，可以带在身边，当个管家什么的。
这个三尾狐乖巧听话，如果化形可以做个专事采买的执事。”
这句话，直接把两个狐狸嗨翻了天，若是姜云天说让她俩化形后伺候自己，现在这俩狐狸也会毫不犹豫。
洗白白擦香香，静等姜云天施为，还会说上一句，“公子随意，我扛得住！”
对于活了几千年的老狐狸，早就看开了，一生执爱，不存在！
从一而终，不可能！
，活命对于她俩来说，才是当下天大的事。
小狸嘻嘻笑道“好呀，好呀。”
小狸能说什么，现在小狸能说什么，姜云天能让人恢复根基和神魂的能力，她就想着让姜云天开心，顺意。
到时候自己也可以水到渠成，恢复巅峰。
对于在能不能打过姜云天，打不赢也不会输，她妖兽身体，扛造的很。
再加上如果恢复到化神三重，她觉得姜云天，小小筑基，可笑可笑！
却见姜云天从储物袋中取出一瓶丹药，说道，我这里有几个凝神丹，你俩拿去用吧。
两狐道：“多李李公子，赤嫣（赤媚）愿为奴为婢，侍奉公子。”
content_en:
The little raccoon boy just watched the show and made comments from time to time.
After a while, Qinglian became more and more confused and began to no longer resist Jiang Yuntian.
After an hour and a half, Jiang Yuntian felt that it was almost done. It took too long and the two foxes maintaining the formation could not hold on. The formation must not reveal its secrets.
On the other side, Jiang Yunhao was already exhausted. Coupled with the blessing of medicine, it lasted for more than an hour. Xiao Huo also fainted and fell to the ground.
This made the two foxes who maintained the operation of the formation look a little embarrassed and dumbfounded.
Xiaoli was different. Looking at Jiang Yuntian's performance, his evaluation of Jiang Yuntian gradually changed from favorable to negative.
She didn't expect Jiang Yuntian to be so violent.
Jiang Yuntian wanted to call it a day, but he thought that it would be a bit unethical if he didn't leave something behind after refining Qinglian's Yuan Yin today. Plus, if it took root, wouldn't it be a coincidence? He could still complete the system task.
Jiang Yuntian stepped out of the illusion formation.
The two foxes glanced at each other and quickly called it a day, returning the little fire to the small raccoon formation.
Xiaohuo is still in a coma.
Outside, Jiang Yunhao was still paralyzed.
Qinglian here is lying straight and motionless, one is recovering blood and the other is recovering soul.
Xiao Li smiled so hard that he couldn't even see his eyes. Jiang Yuntian looked serious. The two foxes didn't dare to say anything. They didn't dare to move when they looked at Xiao Huo who was fainting on the side.
Jiang Yuntian thought about it for a while and thought to himself, "This is the first time I have used this Yin-refining technique in its entirety. The Yin Qi has become much richer, and the Yin-Yang fish has also become a little firmer."
During Jiang Yuntian's training with Qinglian this time, he could feel the loss of Qinglian's spiritual power.
He thought: "Refining is okay. If you don't use it, it will be lost naturally. However, the method of refining the opponent's Yin Qi is somewhat damaged. You may not see the disadvantages after a few times, but it will definitely damage the foundation if you use it too much. Use it sparingly in the future unless it is absolutely necessary."
After all, Qinglian had not been with Jiang Yuntian three years ago. Although she had bared her teeth at him and Qing'er before, she had not done any harm to them. Moreover, Qinglian was also a member of the Qingniao clan. Today, Chiyu was affected. It was also forced by the situation. Jiang Yuntian really felt pity for them.
Jiang Yuntian looked at the little raccoon who kept smiling, and saw two foxes with expectant eyes, and felt relieved.
It seems that although the two foxes captured by Xiaoli worked hard, if his client is not satisfied and Xiaoli gets angry, they will have to return to the west together. Even if they don't return to the west, they will probably lose their skin after the torture.
He smiled and said, "You two did a good job today!"
, worthy of praise!
! "
The two foxes looked grateful.
Jiang Yuntian continued, "Xiao Li, this four-tailed fox is very spiritual. If it turns into a human form, you can take it with you and be a housekeeper or something."
This three-tailed fox is well-behaved and obedient. If he transformed into another form, he could become a butler specializing in purchasing. "
This sentence directly excited the two foxes. If Jiang Yuntian had asked them to transform and serve him, the two foxes would not hesitate now.
Wash and apply fragrance, wait quietly for Jiang Yuntian to do something, and still say, "Young Master, you can do whatever you want, I can handle it!"
For the old fox who has lived for thousands of years, I have long looked away. Love will never exist for a lifetime!
From start to finish, impossible!
, for them, survival is the most important thing at the moment.
Xiaoli giggled and said, "Okay, okay."
What can Xiaoli say? What can Xiaoli say now? Jiang Yuntian can restore people's foundation and soul. She just wants to make Jiang Yuntian happy and contented.
When the time comes, I will be able to succeed and return to my peak.
As for whether she can beat Jiang Yuntian, she won't lose even if she can't win. Her monster body is very strong.
In addition, if she returns to the third level of Shen Transformation, she will think Jiang Yuntian's small foundation building is ridiculous!
But Jiang Yuntian took out a bottle of pills from his storage bag and said, I have a few concentration pills here, you two can use them.
The two foxes said: "Young Master Li, Chi Yan (Chi Mei) is willing to be a slave and a maidservant to serve the Young Master.”
